references.text: Describes the Mediterranean Sea (the great sea) as the western border of Israel's land, the same geographical reference as in Joshua 15:12.
The introduction to the description of Judah's tribal inheritance, with verse 12 concluding with a summary of the borders.
Another part of Judah's border description that mentions the sea as a boundary marker.
Describes the borders for another tribe that also uses the great sea as a reference point.
God's command regarding the boundaries of the land to be distributed among the tribes, including Judah.
A similar summarizing formulation about a tribe's borders 'all around according to their families'.
